name: Grupo Dental Clinics
note: Founded in Málaga around 2014 by three friends including CEO Iván Fernández; 17 clinics across the provinces of Málaga, Granada, Almería, Jaén and Cádiz (club announcement, 2023-12-18). Ownership is not published in any register the research opened, so the parent is unknown and set to itself as an independent private company; nothing invented.
